This document has no R code, so Quarto runs it with Jupyter instead of R. It checks that Jupyter is installed in the Python that Quarto finds.

Python adds the numbers 1 to 10, then prints the path of the Python program that ran it.

```{python}
#| label: python-check
import sys
print("Python runs through Jupyter: expected 55, got", sum(range(1, 11)))
print("Python used:", sys.executable)
```
